```{python}
#| echo: false
# Featured projects — rendered as cards via HTML
projects = [
    {
        "title": "LabSense",
        "tag": "research · embedded",
        "desc": "BLE REST API for capacitive sensor arrays. FastAPI + bleak + aiosqlite, full async architecture. Built for Dr. Ray's lab.",
        "link": "research/labsense.ipynb",
        "status": "active"
    },
    {
        "title": "SVM Credit Default",
        "tag": "ml · coursework",
        "desc": "RBF kernel SVM for credit card default prediction. Deep dive on primal/dual formulation, kernel tricks, class weighting.",
        "link": "coursework/ee445-svm.ipynb",
        "status": "complete"
    },
    {
        "title": "Thermal Characterization Testbench",
        "tag": "research · instrumentation",
        "desc": "Full orchestration pipeline using Keithley SMU and 3D printer bed for automated thermal measurements.",
        "link": "research/thermal-testbench.ipynb",
        "status": "complete"
    },
]

html = '<div class="project-grid">'
for p in projects:
    status_class = "status-active" if p["status"] == "active" else "status-done"
    html += f'''
    <a href="{p["link"]}" class="project-card">
      <div class="project-header">
        <span class="project-title">{p["title"]}</span>
        <span class="project-status {status_class}">{p["status"]}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="project-tag">{p["tag"]}</div>
      <div class="project-desc">{p["desc"]}</div>
    </a>'''
html += '</div>'

from IPython.display import HTML
display(HTML(html))
```
